# Agentic Coding Foundation

> A guide to using coding agents at work. Read the pages relevant to the task, and check the dated primary sources before relying on product behavior.

## Start
- [Agent entry](guide/agent-entry.md): Help a reader choose a task and work within their project's rules.
- [First task](guide/first-task.md): Complete and check a first small change.
- [Supplied practice task](examples/practice-task.md): Use made-up reports and independent CSV answers to check a converter, including failures and reruns.
- [Working loop](guide/workflow.md): Brief the task, inspect the project, make a change, and check the result.

## Practice
- [Context](guide/context.md): Give the agent the right project instructions and task information.
- [Verification](guide/verification.md): Check what the delivered result actually does.
- [Recovery](guide/recovery.md): Diagnose a failure, restore the right state, and resume.
- [Team practice](guide/team-practice.md): Agree who owns the work and how to review it.
- [Advanced practice](guide/advanced.md): Choose skills, tools, parallel work, or automation for a specific need.
- [UX lens skill](examples/skills/ux-lens/SKILL.md): A worked review skill for business-app screens and flows.
- [Platform notes](guide/platforms.md): Check documented differences between tools.
- [Worked task](examples/worked-task.md): Read made-up workplace examples with briefs and checks.
- [Templates](templates/README.md): Copy the parts of a brief, handoff, or lesson that help with the task.

## Maintain
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): Propose and check an edit to the guide.
- [Maintenance](maintenance/README.md): Review sources and choose which updates to adopt.
- [Sources](maintenance/sources.md): See what each source supports and where its evidence stops.
- [Learner scenarios](maintenance/learner-scenarios.md): Try the affected reader routes after changing how the guide teaches.
